facilities.name: Waxdale Plant - Mt. Pleasant WI
facilities.source: Dossier-named flagship; SC Johnson Waxdale Fact Sheet + EPA RMP record (S.C. Johnson & Son Waxdale Plant) + Waze address listing. World's largest/fastest aerosol plant, 2.2M sq ft, 15 production lines, 60M cases/yr.

facilities.source: Dossier-named; SC Johnson careers site + Waze/Yellowpages address listings. ~400 acres, six production buildings, billions of Ziploc bags/yr; co-located distribution operations.

facilities.name: South Side Soapbox Plant (method / Ecover) - Chicago IL
facilities.source: Web research - Chicago Sun-Times, CNI Group, Flickr address listing. 150,000 sq ft LEED-Platinum soap factory in Pullman; manufactures and bottles method/Ecover and serves as their distribution center.
